title: Memo: Amendment to the Service Agreement
paragraphs: Subject: Amendment to the current service agreement

Effective October 1, the term of the current service agreement will be extended by one year. A new clause has been added to address late payment, and the condition regarding the notice period has been updated from thirty days to 45 days.

Any party wishing to object to the amendment must submit a written objection within two weeks. If no objection is received, the amendment will be treated as accepted by all parties and cannot be changed until the next review.
Please direct any questions to the legal affairs office before the effective date.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this memo?
options: To announce an amendment to the service agreement
To cancel the service agreement entirely

questions.stem: How has the notice period changed?
options: It has been reduced to one week

questions.stem: What new clause has been added to the agreement?
What will happen if no department submits a written objection within two weeks?
options: The service agreement will be canceled
The amendment will be treated as accepted by all parties
The notice period will return to thirty days
A new agreement will be drafted
